notes: Inputs: outputs/aggregate_prompt_v1.txt (12 embedded learning-set extractions), schema/rule_library_schema.json, and the 12 extraction files data/extractions/hhh.il0039.sheet.{00001,00003,00005,00006,00007,00008,00012,00013,00017,00019,00020,00021}.json; no other data/ or corpus_a/ file was opened.

Grounding: every rule statement, do-not entry, palette/material/proportion item and signature move is drawn only from the extraction text; nothing was imported from outside knowledge of the architect, building or period.

Evidence file outputs/rule_library_v1_evidence.md carries one verbatim quoted phrase per cited sheet for every rule and do-not entry; all 117 quotes were machine-checked as exact substrings of the corresponding extraction JSON (after JSON decoding), and the evidence ids in the JSON match the evidence file exactly.
generic_rules_removed left empty: the control corpus was not available at this step, so no contrast pass was run.
Palette: colour words exist only in the printed description transcribed on the title sheet (00001); all other sheets are monochrome measured drawings recorded as neutral, and the summary says so.

Mixed evidence declared in-statement with counter-example ids on R09 (leaded-glass pattern; 00020, 00021 draw frames only) and R15 (stippled top-band panels; 00006, 00019, 00020 draw casements only). R04 and R11 note which sheet types show which aspect of the rule.

Two merges were made to stay within the 15-rule cap: ground-storey small-window band merged into the window-ribbon rule (R07), and plain light cap/coping bands merged with horizontal brick coursing (R08).
